description: Confirm a group meeting at a specific time across several Lucie hosts (by @handle), creating ONE shared Google Calendar event with everyone invited. YOU (the connector's owner) are the organizer and host the event on your calendar — no organizer handle needed. This is a real write: it re-verifies every participant (you included) is free at that instant and refuses if anyone isn't — so it never double-books. Always call find_group_times first and copy an exact common-slot start. Before calling, confirm the time (in each person's zone), the participants, the title, and the reason. Requires you to be on Sync Pro (or a Lucie Membership) via your personal connector; everyone must have a live booking page.

durationMinutes.description: Meeting length in minutes. Must be one the organizer offers.

participantHandles.description: The other participants' @handles, e.g. ["@lucie", "@taylor"]. Each must have a live Lucie booking page. Leading @ optional.

reason.description: A short agenda/purpose, shared with everyone on the invite.

startAt.description: The exact ISO-8601 `start` copied verbatim from a find_group_times common slot (absolute UTC instant). Do NOT construct it from a wall-clock time.

title.description: The meeting title, e.g. "Q3 planning sync".

name: book_group_meeting
title: Book a confirmed meeting across several Lucie hosts at once
